forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the email of your account and we’ll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses {email}, a link to set a new password is on its way. It works for one hour.

reset.description: You’ll be signed out on your other devices.
reset.done: Sign in with your new password.
